resources.string: Recording picked up a long way from where it stopped, so there\'s no record of how you covered the ground in between. This walk wasn\'t kept.
Enclose no longer has precise location access, so there\'s nothing to record your route with.
This device wouldn\'t hand over location updates. Check that location is switched on, then try again.
Everything walked so far is still here — press Stop to claim or discard it.
Nothing was recorded, so the walk has been stopped.
Where you\'re standing now becomes your home. The home button brings the map straight back to it; holding the button for three seconds clears it again.
Your home is cleared. The button then asks you to set it again from wherever you are.
There\'s no GPS fix yet, so there\'s nothing to save as home. Wait for your position to show on the map and try again.
This device won\'t let an app rebuild the split from inside it. Drag the divider to the top or bottom edge to end this split, then pair Enclose with the app you want.
This device doesn\'t let an app put itself into split screen. Open Recents, press and hold the Enclose card, choose Split screen, then pick the app for the other half.
The system turned the request down. Picture-in-picture can be switched off per app — check Settings › Apps › Enclose › Picture-in-picture and try again.
You haven\'t closed a loop yet, so nothing will be claimed. Your route so far will be lost.
This walk won\'t use GPS. Tap the map to drop points instead — nothing you actually walk is recorded, and the route can\'t be recovered afterwards.
This run won\'t use GPS. Tap the map to drop points instead — nothing you actually walk is recorded, and the route can\'t be recovered afterwards.
This ride won\'t use GPS. Tap the map to drop points instead — nothing you actually walk is recorded, and the route can\'t be recovered afterwards.
Claim real ground by walking around it.
Your route is traced live on the map, and keeps recording while your screen is off.
Head at least %1$d m away and cover %2$d m or more, then curve back around.
Step back into the dashed circle around your start and close the loop. Everything inside becomes yours — overlapping older claims get carved back.
Under your own power only. Enclose watches how you\'re moving — vehicle trips aren\'t recorded, and driving a loop won\'t claim it.
